messages:
emma-cs: BrightBooks (C-9420) - after today's 08:22 PT rollout they report truncated invoice extracts (missing line_items and total_due) + intermittent 429 and a few 502s on /v1/generate. They need a hotfix/workaround and ETA.

nate-eng: can you paste a sample request id, model, and their curl so we can trace? Also which workspace id?

emma-cs: req id req_20240412_aa77b3, model redwood/gpt-tiny:default, workspace brightbooks-215. curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-tiny:default","input":"Extract invoice fields...","stream":false}'
```
They say errors started immediately after the deploy ping in #eng-releases at 08:21.

rachel-sre: edge metrics show 429 burst 08:22:10-08:26:40 and 502s at 08:23:05. There's also a registry promote event at 08:20:58 for redwood/gpt-tiny:default -> sha256:d4f2...

zoe-ops: paused rate-limiter refresh job at 08:27:12. Billing-migration job also ran at 08:20:45 per ops calendar.

deploy-bot: [08:29:02] rollback started: redwood/gpt-tiny:default -> sha256:1b9e... (requested by nate-eng)

billing-bot: [08:30:10] noticed duplicate meter records for some workspaces between 08:21-08:28; investigating.

nate-eng: immediate mitigations:
- pin BrightBooks to sha256:1b9e... via tenant override (CS)
- rollback :default tag (eng)
- disable billing-migration retry (ops until investigation)
- ask customer to set explicit model to avoid relying on :default

emma-cs: pinned workspace and sent workaround curl with explicit sha + recommend stream=false and increase client timeout to 60s. Asked them to retry and paste new req ids.

rachel-sre: rollback completed 08:33:12. 429/502 rates back near baseline by 08:36.

emma-cs: BrightBooks confirms auth/429/502 mostly gone but still sees missing fields and shorter outputs. Attached two anonymized responses in DM to eng.

nate-eng: registry audit: sha256:d4f2... promoted by CI as part of a "trimmed-output" tuning. Promotion used the release manifest for gpt-tiny but with prompt_template v3-trim. Looks like CI released a tuning build erroneously as :default.

zoe-ops: plan: suspend auto-promotes, add metadata check in CI that verifies prompt_template hash + training commit before promoting. PR infra#452.

nate-eng: eng will canary-promote d4f2... with staged traffic and prompt-level checks (field presence, token length). Schedule: 1% at 09:10 -> 5% at 09:30 -> 20% if checks pass.

deploy-bot: [09:05:00] canary scheduled for sha256:d4f2... -> 1% at 09:10 (owner: nate-eng)

billing-bot: billing duplication root cause: retry loop in migration lambda combined with client retries; billing records dedup key missing. Ops to push a fix and run dedupe job.

finance: flagged for potential usage credits for impacted window 08:21-08:36. CS please coordinate any credit requests.

nate-eng: owners: nate-eng (eng/canary + registry fix), rachel-sre (metrics), zoe-ops (ops/billing), emma-cs (customer comms). Do not re-tag :default until canary passes and we confirm field-level parity.

emma-cs: sent BrightBooks update with ETA ~2h and offered to hold production jobs. They asked to be notified pre-promote. Will send interim updates at 5% and 20% milestones.

nate-eng: added a temporary flag to promote CLI to require --verify-metadata. Also adding tenant override runbook.

emma-cs: closing loop for now; will mark resolved once BrightBooks validates and billing dedupe completes. Last CS update 09:08.
